definition: fraction of test steps where the interval contains the reading the monitor actually received (the perturbed signal). This is what the alert logic reacts to.
fraction of test steps where the interval contains the value the sensor should have reported, i.e. the unperturbed observation.
mean absolute error of the point forecast against the perturbed signal.
mean absolute error of the point forecast against the unperturbed observation: how wrong the forecast is about physical reality.
fraction of test steps at which the frozen k-of-m rule fires.
contiguous alert clusters outside any injected event window, per day.
